source.title: Colombo Consumer Price Index — September 2026
source.publisher: Department of Census and Statistics, Sri Lanka
source.review_method: Manual transcription and visual verification against physical page 4; PDF has no extractable text on that page.

evidence.title: How year-on-year inflation is defined
evidence.text: Year-on-year inflation measures the percentage change in the CCPI over the previous 12 months. The 12-month moving average is a different measure and must not be substituted for year-on-year inflation.

evidence.title: September 2026 release summary
evidence.text: Headline CCPI year-on-year inflation was 8.0% in September 2026, unchanged from August. Food inflation increased from 8.5% to 8.7%; non-food inflation remained 7.7%.

evidence.title: Measure and coverage
evidence.text: Table 03 reports the Colombo Consumer Price Index with base 2021=100, plus headline, food and non-food year-on-year inflation. CCPI and NCPI are distinct indices.
